statement: The Enterprise-D's first mission, to Farpoint Station, runs from stardate 41153.7 to 41174.2.
Ten Forward already existed when Picard took command; a welcoming reception was held there, though season one never shows the room.
Guinan comes aboard as Ten Forward's host in 2365.
The Crystalline Entity stripped the Omicron Theta colony of life before the USS Tripoli found and activated Data there in 2338.
At the branch nobody, Data included, knows Lore exists or connects Data to Noonien Soong; Data knows he was found on Omicron Theta with the colonists' memories.
Canon: the Enterprise surveys Omicron Theta, finds Lore's parts in a hidden lab and reassembles him (41242.4). Lore can communicate with the Crystalline Entity and summons it.

topic: Admiral Quinn and the Inspector General
statement: Canon: Admiral Gregory Quinn, still uninfected and suspicious of something inside Starfleet, sends Lt. Cmdr. Dexter Remmick of the Inspector General's office to investigate the Enterprise and test Picard, and offers Picard the Academy (~41416). Remmick finds nothing wrong.

Canon: parasitic beings take over senior Starfleet officers including Quinn and Remmick; Walker Keel warns Picard at Dytallix B, Keel's Horatio is destroyed, and Picard and Riker confront them at Starfleet Headquarters (41775.5).
Lwaxana Troi holds hereditary Betazoid titles (Daughter of the Fifth House, Holder of the Sacred Chalice of Rixx, Heir to the Holy Rings of Betazed) but is not yet an ambassador; that comes in 2365.
Deanna Troi was genetically bonded as a child to Wyatt Miller; canon has Lwaxana arrive to arrange the wedding (41294.5).
Troi senses emotions in most people, speaks telepathically only with Betazoids and with Riker, and senses nothing from some species such as the Ferengi.
Picard calls his first officer 'Number One' from the Farpoint mission onward.

Starfleet has no record of the Borg. The Hansens studied them from 2347 with backing from the Federation Council on Exobiology and were assimilated aboard the Raven in 2350; Starfleet treated the Borg as myth.
The first officer is expected to lead away teams and to object to the captain going; Picard still beams down several times in season one.
There has been no direct Federation contact with the Romulans since the Tomed Incident in 2311, though they attacked the Klingon outpost at Khitomer in 2346.
Canon: Federation and Romulan outposts along the Neutral Zone are destroyed by an unknown force, and the Romulans break their silence to investigate (41986.0).
The Ferengi are known to the Federation only by rumour, with no contact on record. The ship that destroyed the Stargazer at Maxia in 2355 was Ferengi, but that is not yet known.
Canon: a Ferengi crew steals a T-9 energy converter from Gamma Tauri IV and the Enterprise gives chase, leading to first contact (41386.4).
Picard lost the Stargazer at Maxia in 2355 to an unidentified ship and was court-martialled and exonerated. Jack Crusher had died under his command, and Picard brought the body home.
Canon: DaiMon Bok, whose son died at Maxia, lures Picard with the salvaged Stargazer and a mind-altering device (41723.9).
The ship's computer will tell someone where a crew member is on request; season one shows it but never explains the mechanism.
Live subspace calls work at moderate range; at greater distances a message to Starfleet takes about a day each way.
Code 47 is a captain's-eyes-only emergency channel; the transmission leaves no record in the computer.
Canon: Armus, abandoned on Vagra II by the beings who shed him, wants to leave; he kills Lt. Yar for amusement and holds others to bargain for passage (41601.3).
Miles O'Brien serves aboard the Enterprise-D in 2364 as a junior bridge and relief officer, not yet transporter chief; he fought in the Cardassian war aboard the Rutledge at Setlik III.
The Federation-Cardassian war, under way since the late 2340s, is still unresolved in 2364: a stalemate with skirmishes. A truce comes in 2366 and an armistice in 2367.
Romulan ale is illegal in the Federation from the 2280s until 2375; canon shows senior officers possessing it without being disciplined.
The chief medical officer needs a medical log citing clear evidence of incapacity to relieve the captain; the first officer can do so only with the agreement of all the command officers.
Canon: Q returns and offers the Enterprise's first officer the power of the Q (41590.5).
William Riker was first officer of the USS Hood under Captain DeSoto, refused to let his captain beam down at Altair III, and turned down command of the USS Drake, which went to Paul Rice.
Canon: the USS Drake under Paul Rice is lost at Minos (41798.2).
The chief engineer had not come aboard before Farpoint; season one shows MacDougal, Argyle, Logan and Lynch in the billet at different times.
Canon: the renegades Korris and Konmel, who reject the alliance, are rescued by the Enterprise and hunted by the Empire, testing Worf (41503.7).
Worf was orphaned at Khitomer in 2346 and raised by human foster parents on Gault and Earth; he is the first Klingon in Starfleet (stated later, in DS9).

In 2364: Data is second officer at ops; Geordi La Forge is a lieutenant junior grade at conn; Worf is a lieutenant junior grade relief officer; Tasha Yar, from Turkana IV, is chief of security; Beverly Crusher is a widow and chief medical officer; Wesley Crusher is fifteen.
Canon: the Traveler arrives with propulsion specialist Kosinski's warp-drive modifications and is drawn to Wesley Crusher (41263.1).

Canon's undisturbed course: MacDougal is chief engineer at 41209.2 with Jim Shimoda as assistant chief engineer; Lt. Cmdr. Argyle is chief engineer by 41242-41263 and is called one of the ship's chief engineers, implying more than one in the billet.

At Farpoint the saucer separated at about warp 9.5, a manoeuvre judged inadvisable at any warp with no margin for error; the stardrive turned back and surrendered to Q. At Deneb IV the first officer, on Picard's order, docked manually with no automation, from the battle bridge at about half a metre a second.
The transporter biofilter misses pathogens it has no pattern for; once a pathogen's pattern is acquired it can be reprogrammed to screen it out.
O'Brien was conn officer on the battle bridge during the Farpoint separation.
Starfleet routinely assigns a starship to a Federation world's medical emergency (Styris IV, 2364); outposts also declare emergencies directly to nearby ships.
Groups preserving an Earth heritage culture found colonies of their own; Dorvan V's Native American colony was settled about 2350.

Cardiac replacement with a parthenogenetic implant is established Federation medicine, routine with about 2.4% mortality and done at a starbase in 2365; Picard has had one since 2327 and survived only because a medical facility was near.
Some medicines cannot be replicated: the Ligonian vaccine worked when injected but became unstable when replicated, so the original had to be obtained (2364).

At Farpoint Picard asks his new first officer to keep him from embarrassing himself with the children aboard; he says he is not a family man and is uncomfortable with children, and that a captain needs an image of geniality.
TNG stardates advance about 1000 units a year (41xxx in 2364), about 2.74 a day; a production convention supported on screen only by the season-to-year pattern.
Earth colonies take livestock with them; by the 24th century the normal practice is to carry it as genetic stock rather than live animals. The Mariposa (2123) carried live cattle, chickens and pigs.

Starfleet keeps environmental suits for vacuum work, with magnetic boots as standard so the wearer holds to a hull without gravity; canon shows hull EVA from 2268 (The Tholian Web) and 2273 (TMP) to a suited hull walk in 2373 (First Contact). Suited engineers inspecting hull fittings with handheld scanners is within established capability.

topic: Q aboard at Farpoint and the security response
statement: At the barrier Q appeared in person on the bridge (Picard, Data, Troi, Worf, Yar, Lt. Torres at conn); Torres went for his phaser on stun and Q froze him solid; medics took him to sickbay, which later thawed him out. Crusher was not yet aboard. Worf asked to clean up the bridge and Yar backed him as security chief; Picard refused. No intruder alert or security team was called on any of Q's appearances, including in person on the bridge near Deneb IV. Yar disarmed a soldier in Q's courtroom and was frozen and released.
